channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Blasting beats and neon lights: inside Nairobi's 'nganya' bus culture
item.description: Iranian lawmakers claim the Strait of Hormuz will not return to its pre-war state, citing a permanent shift in the region's dynamics. In Nairobi, the matatu isn't just a ride.

item.title: Global Demand for Rare Earth Minerals Is Intensifying Criminal Threats in the Amazon Rainforest
item.description: Global demand for rare earth minerals is fueling a surge in criminal activity in the Amazon Rainforest, where thieves target critical minerals used in drones and electric cars. Global demand for critical minerals, used to build drones and electric cars, is surging, setting of a new wave of criminality in the world’s largest rainforest.

item.title: Modern economic chokepoints in war and the impact on geopolitics
item.description: The Iran war and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz have exposed modern economic chokepoints, revealing new strategies in geopolitics and war. Hoover Institution fellow Eyck Freymann explains what the Iran war and the blockade of the Straight of Hormuz reveals about modern economic chokepoints, geopolitics and war strategies.

item.title: How does diplomacy work during a military deadlock?
item.description: Diplomatic efforts are underway during a military stalemate, with experts citing nuanced moves to de-escalate tensions and find a peaceful resolution. Suzanne DiMaggio, senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, explains the nuances of diplomatic moves at a time of military stalemate.

item.title: Iran lawmaker says Strait of Hormuz will not return to pre‑war state
item.description: Iran has vowed that the Strait of Hormuz will never return to its pre-war state, following the US-Israel war on Tehran. Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will never return to the status quo that existed before the US-Israel war on Tehran.

item.title: Trump says US will ‘help free up’ ships stuck in Hormuz Strait
item.description: US President Trump said the US will help free up ships stuck in the Hormuz Strait starting Monday. Interference will be dealt with forcefully. US president says any interference with operation, which will start on Monday, will 'have to be dealt with forcefully'.

item.title: Three dead in suspected virus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
item.description: Three people died on an Atlantic cruise ship due to a suspected virus outbreak. One hantavirus case was confirmed. The World Health Organization said one case of hantavirus infection has been confirmed, with five more suspected cases under investigation.

item.title: Three die on Atlantic cruise ship from suspected hantavirus: WHO
item.description: The MV Hondius cruise ship had a suspected hantavirus outbreak. Three people died during the trip from Argentina to Cape Verde. The outbreak occurred on the MV Hondius, travelling from Ushuaia in Argentina to Cape Verde.

item.title: UN Chief Says US Unpaid Dues Worth Billions Are 'Non-Negotiable'
item.description: UN Chief said the US owes billions in unpaid dues. The US unpaid dues are non-negotiable. UN Chief Says US Unpaid Dues Worth Billions Are 'Non-Negotiable' Yahoo.

item.title: Iran says it has received US response to its latest offer for talks
item.description: Iran says it received a US response to its offer for talks, which have continually failed under the fragile ceasefire. Peace talks between the US and Iran have continually failed under the fragile ceasefire.

item.title: Three passengers dead after suspected hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship
item.description: Three people died on a cruise ship in the Atlantic due to a suspected hantavirus outbreak. One case was confirmed by the World Health Organization.

item.title: Israel’s strategy of ‘permanent war’: A race against time?
item.description: Daniel Levy says US policy is heavily influenced by Israeli narratives. Political analyst Daniel Levy says US policy is so ‘marinated’ in Israeli narratives, the two are indistinguishable. Israel’s strategy of ‘permanent war’: A race against time?

item.title: Norway’s Northern Lights Nightmare
item.description: Norwegian authorities have warned tourists about scammers targeting those seeking to see the northern lights in the Arctic region, where tourism has surged in recent years. This Arctic region has seen a boom in tourism, but as tourists chase the northern lights, scammers chase their money.

item.title: How A.I. Is Transforming China’s Entertainment Industry
item.description: China's entertainment industry is experiencing disruption due to the rise of AI-generated microdramas, with celebrities threatening legal action and actors reporting job losses. A. I.-generated microdramas have taken off. Celebrities have threatened legal action against the use of their likeness, while actors say jobs have dried up.

item.title: Germany's Merz says not 'giving up on working with Donald Trump'
item.description: German politician Friedrich Merz has stated that he remains open to working with US President Donald Trump despite recent tensions. Germany's Merz says not 'giving up on working with Donald Trump' Iosco County News Herald.

item.title: Bulk carrier reports 1st attack in weeks near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A bulk carrier reported an attack near the Strait of Hormuz. Live Updates: Bulk carrier reports 1st attack in weeks near Strait of Hormuz CBS News.

item.title: Iran says it is reviewing U.S. response to latest proposal
item.description: A bulk carrier near the Strait of Hormuz was reportedly under attack. The UK military confirmed the incident. Iran's Guards said the US faced two options: an impossible military operation or a bad deal.

item.title: Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say
item.description: A search and rescue operation is underway in Morocco for two US service members who are believed to have been involved in an accident. A search and rescue operation is underway for the service members, who are believed to have been involved in an accident, according to authorities.

item.title: A Perilous Train Ride Home in Pakistan on the Jaffer Express
item.description: The Jaffer Express train is a vital lifeline through Pakistan's Balochistan. We witnessed crossfire while waiting for the Jaffer Express, a vital lifeline through Balochistan. For many, it’s the only way home.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine drones kill four; hit ‘shadow fleet’ tankers
item.description: Russia and Ukraine drones killed four people and hit tankers. Russia fired 268 drones and one ballistic missile in the overnight attack as Ukraine’s army launched at least 334 drones.
